0022600182.text: The Toronto Raptors (4-3, third in the Atlantic and fourth in the East, on a one-game win streak) visit the Denver Nuggets (3-3, fourth in the Northwest and 10th in the West, on a one-game losing streak) in the Raptors' eighth game of the 2026-27 season. Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (lower body) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Raptors lost both 2025-26 meetings, most recently a 121-115 defeat in Denver on March 20, 2026.
